title: On Statistical-Computational Gaps in Graph Combinatorial Testing Problems
abstract: arXiv:2610.41995v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study high-dimensional graph combinatorial hypothesis testing problems in which a signal is supported on the edge set of an unknown subgraph drawn from a class invariant under vertex relabeling. For Gaussian observations, we characterize sharp statistical and computational thresholds (at polynomial order) for the signal magnitude required for strong detection across various combinatorial graph alternatives. Our analysis is based on bounding the second moments of the full and low-degree likelihood ratios in terms of the overlap of two independent latent structures and comparing the resulting lower bounds with scan, average, and coordinatewise maximum tests. translated_title: 论图组合检验问题中的统计-计算鸿沟
translated_abstract: 我们研究高维图组合假设检验问题，其中信号支撑在一个未知子图的边集上，该子图抽自一个在顶点重标记下保持不变的图类。对于高斯观测数据，我们在多种组合图备择假设下，刻画了强检测所需信号强度的精确统计阈值与计算阈值（在多项式阶上）。我们的分析基于利用两个独立潜在结构之间的重叠来控制完全似然比与低度似然比的二阶矩，并将由此得到的下界与扫描检验、平均检验和逐坐标最大值检验进行比较。在适当的低度计算难度猜想下，我们获得了与高斯子矩阵检测中已知阈值相匹配的种植团阈值，并识别出多种植团、超团、粗循环和粗路径等问题上新的统计-计算鸿沟。
tldr: 本文刻画了图组合假设检验问题中强检测所需信号强度的精确统计阈值与计算阈值，并首次识别出多种植团、超团、粗循环和粗路径等问题上新的统计-计算鸿沟。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes sharp statistical and computational thresholds for strong detection in graph combinatorial hypothesis testing, and identifies new statistical-computational gaps for multiple planted cliques, hypercliques, thick cycles, and thick paths.
